tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: the sidebar.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Page ground: the conversation and lists.

tokens.name: bg-150
tokens.usage: The Details panel, set slightly apart from the conversation.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Raised: cards, the message box, artifact cards, agent rows.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Hover, and the highlighted message under the pointer.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: The selected item: the open conversation in the sidebar, a pressed toggle. Neutral on purpose: yolk is saved for actions.

tokens.name: border-100
tokens.usage: Hairlines between areas: sidebar edge, header rule, dividers.

tokens.name: border-200
tokens.usage: Control borders: secondary buttons, the message box, cards. 3:1 against the ground.

tokens.name: text-100
tokens.usage: Main text: messages, names, titles.

tokens.name: text-200
tokens.usage: Secondary text: previews, descriptions, idle nav items.

tokens.name: text-300
tokens.usage: Quiet text: times, counts, section labels, hints. Still 4.5:1 on bg-100.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Deep yolk, the one action color: primary buttons, Send, the brand mark, progress bars. Yolk means "do something".

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent. Always dark: white is not readable on yolk.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, and the # before the open conversation.

tokens.name: mention-bg
tokens.usage: Behind an @mention of someone else.

tokens.name: mention-ink
tokens.usage: An @mention of someone else.

tokens.name: you-bg
tokens.usage: Behind an @mention of you: a stronger yolk than other mentions.

tokens.name: you-ink
tokens.usage: An @mention of you.

tokens.name: you-row
tokens.usage: The whole row of a message that mentions you.

tokens.name: agent
tokens.usage: The agent spark badge on avatars, in sky. Only ever means "this is an agent".

tokens.name: agent-ink
tokens.usage: The spark drawn inside the agent badge.

tokens.name: agent-label
tokens.usage: The small 'agent' word after an agent's name, and an agent's live status ('Fact-checking…'). Sky, like the badge.

tokens.name: notify
tokens.usage: Every count badge: unread conversations, Approvals. Means 'look here'. Nothing else is red.

tokens.name: notify-ink
tokens.usage: The number on a count badge.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, approved, free: text and icons. Lime.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Behind a success chip ('Approved Draft 2').

tokens.name: waiting
tokens.usage: Needs you: "Waiting for you", a pending approval. Yolk, because it asks you to act.

tokens.name: waiting-bg
tokens.usage: Behind a card that needs your OK.

tokens.name: waiting-border
tokens.usage: Border of a card that needs your OK, and of the busy agent's row.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Stuck or failed: the reason line and its icon.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Behind a 'stuck' card.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Border of a 'stuck' card.

tokens.usage: The initials on person-1-bg.

tokens.usage: A person's avatar ground (violet, second).

tokens.usage: The initials on person-2-bg.

tokens.usage: A person's avatar ground (rose, third).

tokens.usage: The initials on person-3-bg.

tokens.name: person-4-bg
tokens.usage: A person's avatar ground (slate, fourth).

tokens.name: person-4-ink
tokens.usage: The initials on person-4-bg.
